[P1] Presentation alternatives - choose what a placement shows
|
|-- document.alternatives: DiagramAlternatives
|   |-- schemaVersion: 1
|   |-- items[id]: DiagramAlternative
|   |   |-- id / name / diagramId / presentationId
|   |   |-- display?: regular | diff
|   |   |-- parentAlternativeId?         nested choice
|   |   |-- reviewId?                    optional review relationship -> [P2]
|   |   `-- parts[]                     one atomic presentation choice
|   |       |-- target                  whole diagram OR subtree nodeRef
|   |       |-- source                  revisionId + source scope
|   |       `-- baseRevisionId          pinned comparison / target context
|   |-- selected[presentationId]        independently selected choice IDs
|   `-- panels[id]                     attached SidePanel records
|
|-- Promote                            nodes.promoteAlternative(...)
|   |-- pin existing source and base revisions
|   |-- parts target disjoint scopes of one base revision
|   `-- retain true revision ancestry
|
|-- Select                             nodes.selectAlternative(...)
|   |-- swap all parts together
|   |-- explicitly replace overlapping choices
|   `-- nested choices require their selected parent
|
|-- Project                            alternativeSelections(...)
|   `-- projectSelectedDiagramRows(...) -> source rows + provenance
|       `-- bound Diagram revision stays unchanged
|
`-- Compare                            nodes.sidePanel(...)
    |-- pin one alternative part
    |-- attach to a placement and logical nodeRef
    `-- regular / diff; flow / overlay -> rendering in Proposal 3

Example: two placements share revision R0.
Placement A selects a subtree from R1; placement B still shows R0.
Both remain bound to R0. Each placement owns its presentation choices.
Canvas checkpoints retain choices, panels, and referenced revisions.

Sources: domain/core/presentation/diagramAlternative.ts
         domain/mapping/workspace/diagramAlternatives.ts
         domain/core/presentation/diagramRevisionProjection.ts
